scene.note: Whatever goes wrong, the radio goes back to the team's channel and the log stays whole, and the error still reaches the caller.

steps.note: The radio is tuned to each channel in turn, and each is listened to.
What was heard on each channel comes back, in order.
Afterwards the radio is on the channel it started on, even when a dead channel stopped the scan.
The error from a dead channel still travels on to the code that called.
The log is opened and each entry's line is written into it.
When an entry stops with an error, the file is closed all the same.
The error carries on to the code that called.
Every entry's line is made before the file is touched.
Only when every line is ready is the file written, all at once.
When an entry is wrong, the error reaches the caller and the file is as it was before.
